title.en: Chapter 22 — The River Under the Mountain

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: I found a river going inside the mountain.

sentences.ar: ما كنت بعرف على وين بيوصل.
sentences.en: I did not know where it led.

sentences.ar: عملت طوافة من خشب السفن المكسورة.
sentences.en: I made a raft from the wood of the broken ships.

sentences.ar: حطيت عليها ألماس وعنبر من الجبل.
sentences.en: I put diamonds and ambergris from the mountain on it.

sentences.ar: قلت لحالي: يا بموت هون، يا بوصل.
sentences.en: I said to myself: either I die here, or I arrive.
I pushed the raft into the river and entered the darkness.
